rows.capability: bounded source collection and raw observation persistence
rows.evidence: Synthetic connector execution persists bounded raw observations; the observation list exposes the persisted evidence and collection state.

rows.capability: feed, GitHub and Google Trends connector boundaries
rows.evidence: Provider responses are bounded at connector boundaries and normalized into the common observation contract; connector tests use MOCK responses.

rows.capability: source health, circuit and retry state
rows.evidence: Probe outcomes update source health, retry and circuit state; operations UI and health API expose the resulting state.

rows.capability: keyword normalization, aliases and quality
rows.evidence: Synthetic title/text input is normalized, alias-aware and materialized as keyword mentions used by the opportunity workflow.

rows.capability: keyword quality and evidence trace
rows.evidence: Quality decisions retain bounded evidence linkage and reject low-quality synthetic mentions before they influence derived results.

rows.capability: weekly trend contract, aggregation and persistence
rows.evidence: Time-bounded synthetic mentions aggregate into a versioned weekly report, persist idempotently and render in the dashboard/export path.

rows.capability: opportunity clusters, lineage and graph relations
rows.evidence: Bounded graph relations form deterministic opportunity clusters; cluster generations and lineage are retained in database models.

rows.capability: opportunity scoring and evidence breakdown
rows.evidence: Synthetic normalized signals produce a versioned score snapshot and visible evidence breakdown without replacing human-owned research state.

rows.capability: provider analysis queue and citations
rows.evidence: The durable analysis queue claims and retries MOCK provider work; completed or degraded analysis is returned with citation bindings.

rows.capability: research workflow and human-owned state
worker_targets: N/A - human-owned research state is changed synchronously by the API
rows.evidence: Research status, priority, tags, notes and starred state round-trip through the API and opportunity detail UI.

rows.capability: alert rule evaluation and event lifecycle
rows.evidence: Rule evaluation creates lifecycle events and only permitted NEW-to-ACKNOWLEDGED/DISMISSED/RESOLVED transitions are accepted.

rows.capability: high-signal alert eligibility and acceptance
rows.evidence: Eligibility requires the configured score, risk and evidence gates; duplicate and suppressed synthetic events remain auditable.

rows.capability: keyword burst detection, evidence and replay
rows.evidence: Bounded daily synthetic series are evaluated with deterministic baseline/anomaly rules; replay returns the same evidence and decision.

rows.capability: new tool/product normalization and alerts
rows.evidence: Multi-source synthetic occurrences normalize to stable tool/product entities and emit first-seen alerts with duplicate suppression.

rows.capability: hiring surge detector and mock replay
rows.evidence: The hiring detector consumes only bounded MOCK job observations in acceptance tests and preserves no-evidence versus surge states.

rows.capability: cross-source confirmation and independence
rows.evidence: Confirmation requires independent synthetic evidence endpoints and suppresses events that do not meet the configured independence threshold.

rows.capability: score jump and risk escalation explanations
rows.evidence: Versioned synthetic score/risk snapshots produce explainable jump/escalation records with duplicate keys and replayable evidence.

rows.capability: versioned email contract and durable queue
ui_targets: N/A - email delivery is a backend queue capability; its durable records are exposed by the API
rows.evidence: Alert email records are durably queued, claimed with leases, retried by policy and sent through the MOCK or SMTP adapter without false success.

rows.capability: versioned Webhook contract, endpoint and queue
ui_targets: N/A - webhook delivery is a backend queue capability; endpoint and delivery records are exposed by the API
rows.evidence: Webhook records are durably queued, leased, retried and terminally classified through the versioned endpoint and event contract.

rows.capability: Webhook SSRF, DNS and signature boundary
ui_targets: N/A - security policy is enforced before backend delivery and is covered by API tests
rows.evidence: MOCK endpoint checks enforce scheme, DNS/IP policy, redirect refusal, timeout bounds and signatures before network delivery.

worker_targets: N/A - the receiver is an isolated HTTP service; the product worker is mapped under FM-DEL-002
rows.evidence: The isolated MOCK receiver verifies signatures, captures receipts and rejects duplicate event IDs for Docker acceptance.

ui_targets: N/A - provider-neutral contract is consumed by backend delivery
rows.evidence: The typed provider-neutral request/result contract carries version, idempotency, retryability and failure semantics for synthetic delivery flows.

rows.capability: Mock Enterprise Messaging service

worker_targets: N/A - the Mock service is isolated; product worker integration is mapped under FM-ENT-004
rows.evidence: The isolated MOCK service records sent messages, enforces idempotency and exposes deterministic failure modes for Docker acceptance.

ui_targets: N/A - routing templates and fallback traces are backend delivery records

worker_targets: N/A - authorization is enforced synchronously at the API boundary
rows.evidence: Synthetic authenticated requests exercise RBAC, CSRF, token and admin boundaries; denied requests return the contract status instead of partial success.

rows.capability: request audit and request/trace correlation
rows.evidence: API requests carry request/trace correlation into audit records and structured logs; the operations view exposes the audit stream.

rows.capability: worker heartbeat, leases and observability metrics
rows.evidence: Worker iterations emit heartbeat and metrics state through independent health updates, including idle, error and stale classifications.

rows.capability: probe scheduler and worker mode boundaries
rows.evidence: Due synthetic probe tasks are planned, claimed and completed with next-run scheduling and retry state visible in operations.

rows.capability: migration, backup/restore and product hardening
